correction: Supersedes any earlier broad statement that heat goal least-squares operations are all outside host-ready timing. There are two distinct goal representations and call paths.
inside_request_preparation: run_e2_timing.request calls nominal_lqr_action before the request_preparation mark.

For heat, nominal_lqr_action constructs the seven-mode goal projection using np.linalg.lstsq(modal,goal), then solves the steady-input least-squares problem. Both calls are inside request_preparation.
Modal observation reconstruction and B0 gain lookup/construction are also inside request_preparation.
outside_request_boundary: closed_loop._goal_coeff constructs32 heat goal coefficients for neural observations when replay observations were originally assembled. These stored goal_coefficients are read by E2; that32-mode least-squares solve is not re-executed inside E2.request.
CachedOperator initialization precomputes model-specific trunk output and spatial basis before warmup and timed requests.
model_path_static_facts: Uncached heat spatial_basis executes32 Python-loop iterations, each making a device scalar wave_number, sinusoidal terms and the linear endpoint-roundoff correction.
The periodic Burgers basis uses16 harmonic iterations with sine and cosine, plus a constant basis.

The profile field_assembly_and_other remainder contains spatial_basis, initial-head work, field combinations and instrumentation overhead; the current profiler does not isolate individual basis operations.
Cache on precomputes both trunk output and spatial basis; an observed timing change cannot be assigned exclusively to either one without a further controlled measurement.
gain_cache_lifecycle: The E2 runner uses one process for all three randomized-condition sessions and does not clear these gain caches between conditions/sessions.
Every condition uses the specified50warmup requests, plus four equivalence-check observations; this does not imply a cold process or complete gain-cache prewarming.
All recorded requests and outliers remain in the primary analysis; no retrospective removal or timing restart is authorized by this static finding.
interpretation_limit: Use completed stage profiles to describe observed associations. This code inspection does not measure milliseconds, isolate a causal share of the heat/Burgers gap, or establish an effect of persistent gain caches. Three sequential sessions are not independently restarted environments.
